Hora, Nathonnatha, Ayana, aggregate Kaala, non-luminary Chesta, Drik, Sthana, and full Shadbala remain uncertified.

Abda, Masa, Vara, Tribhaga, Paksha, and Yuddha are aligned in 35/35 visible Kaala rows. The gate compares the actual production source profile: Sthana passes 1/35 and full total passes 3/35. Dig, aggregate Kaala, Chesta, Drik, Sthana, and full total remain provisional. Independent witness alignment is not source certification, financial validation, or execution permission.

Production Sthana passes 1 of 35 rows, but there is no visible independent breakdown for Uchcha, Saptavargaja, Ojayugma, Kendradi, and Drekkana. A fail-closed 175-row capture contract now rejects missing, inferred, unhashed, or top-level-inconsistent values. No production formula or tolerance changes are admitted until that witness is complete.

A fail-closed two-part packet now requires seven visible case-8 Hora rows tied to one JHora sunrise input and seven historical Ayana rows tied to visible JHora tropical longitude or Kranti. No production formula, tolerance, ML feature, Auto Suggest rule, live inference, or execution path changes while those templates remain pending.

An independent Krishna Rau witness supports the 11|15 correction candidate and 1/20 reference unit, but 2|18 and score-to-price arithmetic remain unresolved.

Only guarded direction/reference-unit evidence is available; direct price, market labels, Auto Suggest, inference and execution remain blocked.

Four additional private files were classified without double counting: the Khemraj file is a same-lineage Trailokya reprint, the unattributed introduction is a Phaladeepika-derived duplicate and is excluded, the P.V.R. article is modern reference commentary, and selected Krishna Rau/Choudhary financial pages are an opt-in hypothesis reference. No deterministic SBC or trading capability is upgraded.

Research mechanics are tested. A narrow Trailokya Vedha profile now exists, but its financial Arghya layer and the complete Agarwal profile remain blocked; a separate purged validation gate is still required.
